items.title: Linkdaze’s smart calendar is built to run a household, not just track a schedule
items.summary: Linkdaze's smart digital calendar stands out for not putting its features behind a paywall, including an AI meal planner tool.

items.title: Grok keeps sending gibberish responses to users
items.summary: Affected users told TechCrunch they were using Grok Lite, and noticed the issues as early as Wednesday morning.

items.title: The investor’s guide to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: Everything you need to know
items.summary: Year after year, investors who've explored the Expo Halls, met founders, and learned from peers have proven why you need to be on the ground at Disrupt this year.

items.title: A third of web pages published since ChatGPT’s launch show signs of AI authorship, study finds
items.summary: ChatGPT and other AI models are now authoring and editing much of the new web.

items.title: Early Cerebras investor Adit Singh joins Mayfield as infrastructure partner
items.summary: At Mayfield, Singh will focus on semiconductor, cybersecurity, and physical AI investments.

items.title: Ramp launches its own AI model router, called Router
items.summary: Ramp has launched its own AI model routing service, dubbed Router, that lets users and companies use and switch between various large language models via an API.

items.title: Senators demand answers from TikTok over experiment that disabled safeguards
items.summary: The safeguard was designed to prevent users from being overwhelmed by harmful content, but TikTok wanted to determine whether it made the app less engaging.

items.title: Meta brings Pocket, an app that lets you vibe-code and share games, to US users
items.summary: Meta is bringing Pocket, its experimental AI-powered app for creating and sharing interactive games, to users across the U.S. after quietly testing it in Brazil.

items.title: The 2026 Startup Battlefield 200 is here — see who made the cut
items.summary: We’re thrilled to unveil the 2026 Startup Battlefield 200, our annual handpicked list of the 200 most promising early-stage startups from around the world.

items.title: Patreon launches 30 new creator features, including short-form Clips and revamped discovery
items.summary: Patreon is overhauling how creators get discovered, adding short-form Clips, topic-based communities, and a revamped recommendation system designed to give smaller creators more visibility.

items.title: Inertia Enterprises finds a way to make its fusion fuel fast
items.summary: Fusion power startup Inertia Enterprises reduced the fuel filling process from a week to just a few hours. It's one of 10 hurdles the company must overcome to make a profitable power plant.

items.title: There are less than 48 hours to save up to $300 on your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 ticket
items.summary: If you’ve been circling around Disrupt, then now’s the best time to lock in your pass and start getting ready to join the rest of the startup community gathering in San Francisco from October 13-15 at Moscone West!

items.title: Apollo Atomics wants to make nuclear power cheaper by shrinking an overlooked part
items.summary: Y Combinator alumnus Apollo Atomics is shrinking a key nuclear reactor part, which promises to slash the cost of electricity below natural gas.

items.title: AI data giant Alation confirms cyberattack
items.summary: The data search and AI giant confirmed unauthorized access to its systems during an incident on Tuesday, and said it was investigating the breach.

items.title: For a16z, AI gives foreign founders an advantage
items.summary: a16z’s Borderless Founder network initiative supports immigrant and international founders. "Having one foot in your home country, and one foot in Silicon Valley" is an advantage, the firm believes.

items.title: US says hackers are targeting vulnerable water systems with the help of AI
items.summary: Hackers are targeting internet-connected Siemens controllers used in water facilities around the United States.

items.title: Meta AI’s new Mac app wants you to talk to your apps
items.summary: The company said that the dictation feature works across all apps, just like other tools such as Wispr Flow, Superwhisper, and Monologue.

items.title: Binance now lets AI agents trade, but keeping them in check is largely up to users
items.summary: Binance's Agent OS works with tools such as ChatGPT, Claude Code, and Cursor.

items.title: Stripe didn’t really buy OpenRouter because of the ‘singularity’
items.summary: What does a payments giant want with a startup that routes prompts between different AI models? Stripe says it's because of "the singularity" but it's really for a far more real and powerful reason.

items.title: Waymo’s cheaper, next-gen robotaxi is now open to all riders in these three cities
items.summary: The next-generation robotaxi, called the Waymo Ojai, is central to the company's push towards mass scale, and eventually, profitability.
